name: pixel-no-cover-shows-scene
why: A song without a cover (or before it downloads, or when the fetch fails) shows its mood scene in pixels, not an empty ░ box.

name: pixel-cover-replaces-scene
why: When the cover arrives it takes the scene's place.

name: pixel-queue-end-restores-scene
why: When the queue ends the last cover used to stay forever; the scene comes back.

name: pixel-launch-shows-scene
why: At launch, with nothing playing, the art box shows a scene too.

name: pixel-motion-off-still-frame
why: motion off: no timer, but the scene and the visualizer still draw one still frame.

name: pixel-mini-sprite-60x10
why: F2 on a window 8+ rows tall shows the cassette beside the mini line, and the line still fits its time.

name: pixel-mini-no-sprite-60x6
why: Under 8 rows the mini player keeps its two lines, no cassette.

name: pixel-mini-vinyl-for-retro-tape
why: The retro tape theme (vinyl motif) gets a vinyl instead of the cassette.

name: pixel-garish-theme-renders
why: A garish LLM theme still draws its scene and visualizer (colours come from the normalized palette).
